track.title: The test track
track.body: The test track replays with a simulated operator what happens in production. Successful payment, insufficient balance, duplicate or late webhook, timeout. No merchant account.
track.alt: Test track with the scenarios on the left, the inspector and the JSON response of a payment session, then the delivery of the checkout.session.completed webhook.

routes.title: The itineraries
routes.body: An itinerary is an integration sheet for one service, country and stack. It gives the code that works and the known traps, and says whether the road is clear, to verify or reported broken, with the date of the last check.
routes.alt: Itinerary sheet, here a Wave payment session in PHP, its known traps, then a pothole reported by another developer.
routes.toVerify: The last check is old, one try is enough.
routes.broken: Open potholes, to fix before use.
